summary: Fraser Brothers Group is an independent, multi-line insurance agency headquartered at 811 Amboy Avenue in Edison, NJ, with affiliated offices in Belford (DeLaurier Insurance Agency) and Tinton Falls (Kennedy & Ward Insurance Agency). It sells personal, commercial, life and health lines and represents roughly 40 carriers, with a team page listing 17 staff across the three offices. Intake is phone- and web-form driven with no online booking or instant quoting, and all three offices keep short weekday-only hours (earliest close 4:15 PM).

facts.fact: Headquarters at 811 Amboy Avenue, Edison, NJ 08837; main phone 732.738.7400, fax 732.738.9135.

Three offices are listed: Fraser Brothers Insurance Agency (Edison), DeLaurier Insurance Agency (878 Main Street, Belford, NJ 07718), and Kennedy & Ward Insurance Agency (1201 Sycamore Avenue, Tinton Falls, NJ 07724).
Office hours are weekday-only and differ by location: Edison Mon-Fri 8:15 AM-4:15 PM, Belford Mon-Fri 9:00 AM-5:00 PM, Tinton Falls Mon-Fri 8:30 AM-4:30 PM.

Product scope spans personal lines (auto, home, flood, renters, umbrella, boat, classic car, RV, motorcycle), commercial lines (auto dealers, bonds, business liability, commercial auto/property, contractors, cyber liability, E&O, farm, group health, landlord liability, liquor liability, restaurant, workers compensation), and life & health (disability income, life, long-term care, Medicare supplement, group health, Aflac voluntary benefits).

The agency represents about 40 carriers including Travelers, The Hartford, Chubb, AIG, CNA, Liberty Mutual, Nationwide, Progressive, Selective, Philadelphia Insurance, Zurich, MetLife, Mutual of Omaha and Aflac, and publishes each carrier's claims and service phone numbers.
The team page lists 17 named staff across the three offices (9 Edison, 6 Tinton Falls, 2 Belford).
William R Vowteras is listed as Principal at the Edison office, extension 102.
The claims page tells clients to call the office during regular business hours to report a claim, and notes many carriers accept initial claims 24 hours a day.
Quote and contact intake runs through embedded Agency Revolution web forms (separate personal and commercial form IDs) plus a secure file upload link hosted at crm.bridge.insure.
The site is built on the FMG Suite agency website platform and carries Agency Revolution content-library disclaimers and a 2026 copyright.

The sitemap contains no careers or employment page; it lists home, contact, team profiles, service pages and a large auto-populated resource-center article library with entries dated through November 2026.

operations_signals: No online booking, scheduling or instant-quote tool anywhere on the site; the only online paths are 'Request a Quote' web forms and a generic contact form submitted to the FMG platform (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/contact)

Phone-first claims intake: clients are told to call the office during regular business hours, with carrier 24-hour claim lines as the after-hours fallback, so the agency itself appears to offer no after-hours coverage (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/claims-center)

Short weekday-only hours, and they differ by office (Edison closes 4:15 PM, Tinton Falls 4:30 PM, Belford 5:00 PM), which limits when customers can reach a person (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/contact)

Three offices operate under three separate agency brand names (Fraser Brothers, DeLaurier, Kennedy & Ward) with separate phone and fax lines and separate hours, implying duplicated intake and coordination across locations (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/contact)
Secure document intake runs through a third-party CRM portal link (crm.bridge.insure) rather than an agency-branded client portal (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/)
Service area spans Middlesex and Monmouth counties in central/northern New Jersey based on the Edison, Belford and Tinton Falls office locations (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/contact)

Published service model includes 1-on-1 strategy meetings, annual policy check-ups and coverage assessments, i.e. scheduled human touchpoints rather than self-service (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/services)
hiring_signals: No careers or employment page exists on the site; the sitemap lists no jobs URL (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/sitemap.xml)

No open postings could be verified: Indeed, LinkedIn Jobs, Glassdoor and ZipRecruiter all blocked automated access during this research, so no role list can be confirmed (research limitation, no source URL)
review_themes: No customer reviews could be retrieved: Google Business Profile, Yelp, BBB and Glassdoor blocked automated access, so no themes on responsiveness, billing or scheduling can be reported (research limitation, no source URL)
tech_footprint: Website hosted on the FMG Suite agency CMS platform (generator meta tag and static.fmgsuite.com asset paths) (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/)
Lead capture and quote forms delivered by Agency Revolution embedded form scripts with separate personal and commercial form IDs (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/)

Content marketing is largely an Agency Revolution / FMG content library: dozens of generic 'did you know' and glossary articles re-dated through late 2026, rather than original agency writing (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/sitemap.xml)
Client data exchange via a Bridge CRM cloud upload portal at crm.bridge.insure (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/)
Google Analytics (UA-6877275-1 and G-90NR43CZBZ) and Datadog browser RUM instrumentation on the site (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/)
Accessibility overlay widget from accessiBe/FMG Suite loaded sitewide (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/)
Google Maps embeds on the locations page for each office, with no chat widget or live-chat tool detected (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/contact)
Social presence limited to Facebook, Twitter/X (@4NJInsurance) and LinkedIn company page links in the header and footer (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/)
growth_signals: The group operates three agency brands across three towns, suggesting growth by affiliation or acquisition of established local agencies (DeLaurier in Belford, Kennedy & Ward in Tinton Falls) under the Fraser Brothers name (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/meet-the-team)

Commercial appetite has been broadened to niche programs such as auto dealers, contractors, restaurant, liquor liability, bonds, cyber liability and E&O, pointing to a broad commercial book handled by a small team (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/services)
Aflac voluntary benefits have been added alongside group health, indicating an employee-benefits cross-sell push into existing commercial accounts (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/)
No expansion news, awards or press coverage could be verified; Google News returned no items for the agency or its affiliate brands (research limitation, no source URL)
decision_maker: William R Vowteras, Principal — listed with the title 'Principal' on the agency's own team page (https://www.fraserbrothers.com/team/william-vowteras)

inferences.inference: Quote intake is human-gated and likely a bottleneck for after-hours and peak-season demand.
inferences.reasoning: The site offers only web forms and phone numbers, with no online rating, booking or chat; office hours end between 4:15 and 5:00 PM on weekdays, so leads arriving evenings or weekends wait until the next business day. An AI intake/quoting assistant could capture and triage those requests 24/7.

inferences.inference: Certificate-of-insurance, renewal and endorsement requests probably consume a large share of staff time.
inferences.reasoning: A 17-person team servicing roughly 40 carriers across personal, commercial, life/health and employee benefits implies heavy document handling; the only 'self-service' mechanism is a generic secure-upload portal, which still requires a human to read and route each file.

inferences.inference: Managing three brands with three sets of hours, phone numbers and branding creates coordination and consistency overhead.
inferences.reasoning: Contact data shows separate names, lines and schedules per office, while the marketing site funnels everything through one Edison-centric header, so call routing, messaging and client expectations likely diverge by location.

inferences.inference: The agency's content marketing is largely vendor-generated and unlikely to differentiate it locally.
inferences.reasoning: The sitemap shows a large, regularly re-dated library of generic insurance explainer articles with Agency Revolution disclaimers, not agency-authored material; AI-assisted locally-focused content and lead nurture could fill that gap cheaply.

inferences.inference: The mapper's note about bilingual service and online self-service could not be confirmed on the public site.
inferences.reasoning: No Spanish-language pages, bilingual staff call-outs, or self-service portal were visible on the home, services, contact, team or claims pages reviewed; the 'online self-service' may refer only to the quote and upload forms.

inferences.inference: Commercial niche breadth (auto dealers, contractors, restaurants, bonds) on a small team points to repetitive submission and renewal administration.
inferences.reasoning: Each niche typically requires distinct carrier submissions, supplemental applications and certificates; with about 40 markets and a modest staff, per-account work is high relative to headcount.

data_gaps: Customer review content and ratings could not be retrieved: Google Business Profile, Yelp, BBB and Glassdoor all blocked automated access.
Job postings could not be verified: Indeed, LinkedIn Jobs, Glassdoor and ZipRecruiter returned 403 errors, and the agency has no careers page.
Years in business / founding date not stated on the site and not verifiable without the NJ business registry, which requires an interactive search.
Employee count is inferred from 17 named team profiles; no headcount, revenue or premium-volume figures are published.
No named owner or principal was found for the Belford (DeLaurier) or Tinton Falls (Kennedy & Ward) offices beyond the Edison Principal listing.

Web search providers were rate-limited or unavailable for most of this session, so local news, awards and press mentions could not be searched; Google News returned zero items for the agency and its affiliate brands.
The mapper's claims of bilingual service and online self-service were not corroborated by any page reviewed.
